summary: Very steep narrow kerb, houses 16 m away, no room to pull out.
reasons: Houses 16-17 m away on west side
Narrow lane, bush right to edge

drivers.seclusion: East side is bush, but houses sit 16 m and 17 m away across a narrow road.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street, but the east side is trees to the lane edge, so no clear level ground to pull off.
drivers.traffic: Quiet street; a busy road runs beyond the bush to the east.
drivers.convention: No parked cars or markings seen.

sun_shade: Dense tree canopy over the east side; shaded most of the day.

best_section.where: Top end of the east kerb, just south of the Carinya Street bend
